name: MCNASH14
tagline: Intel Core i5-12500H / i7-13620H NAS PC with four 2.5GbE ports
description: MCNASH14 combines Intel Core i5-12500H or i7-13620H processors, up to 64GB DDR5, four Intel i226 2.5GbE ports, M.2 NVMe and SATA storage, and PCIe expansion in a 150 x 143 x 84 mm enclosure. It uses 12V DC input and supports optional network expansion.

specs.label: CPU
specs.value: Intel® Core™ i5-12500H / Intel® Core™ i7-13620H

specs.label: Graphics
specs.value: Intel UHD Graphics for 12th Gen Intel Processors

specs.label: Display
specs.value: 1 x DP port; 1 x HDMI port

specs.label: Network
specs.value: 4 x Intel i226 RJ45 2.5 GbE; expandable to 20G/40G SFP+ or 4 additional LAN ports

specs.label: Storage
specs.value: 1 x M.2 NVMe 2280 (PCIE4.0 x 4)/1 x SATA3.0

specs.label: Expansion
specs.value: 1 x PCIe x8 slot (PCIe 3.0 x4); 1 x M.2 3052 (PCIe 3.0/USB); 1 x M.2 2230 (PCIe 3.0/USB/CNVi); Wake-on-LAN; PXE

specs.label: Network panel I/O
specs.value: 2 x USB2.0; 4 x 2.5G Ethernet port; 1 x DC_IN; 1 x DP+HDMI

specs.label: USB and control panel I/O
specs.value: 2 x USB3.0; 1 x Power Button; 1 x Type-C; 1 x SIM Card Slot; 1 x CONSOLE

specs.label: Internal I/O - Headers
specs.value: 1 x SATA; 1 x SATA_PWR; 2 x SO-DIMM DDR5 Slot; 1 x PCIE X8; 1 x M.2 Wi-Fi/1 x M.2(3052)/1 x M.2(2280); 1 x CLR_CMOS; 1 x JGPIO; 1 x F_USB; 1 x JTPM; 1 x CPU_FAN
